items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: one of them was with Robert Morley, who is a favorite of mine

ctx.x: Yeah that’s the best way. Because if you try to pour it it’s going to be all over the saucer. I just watched three of the Miss Marple movies with Margaret Rutherford. Did you ever see those things? You should buy those, those are great. They’re made with MGM money that they earned in England, and at that time you couldn’t take it out so they started making movies over there, and they found this Margaret Rutherford woman who had been a Vaudevillian for years, and she was kind of past her prime so they cast her as…
Can we put this over here?
